maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is insurance premiums on homeowners and commercial auto policies, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Premiums are paid by homeowners and commercial auto policyholders, who are private consumers and businesses, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by writing more policies through agents and brokers in New York and nearby states, not by acquiring companies.

mission_critical.reason: Homeowners and auto policyholders can change carriers at renewal through their agents, so switching cost is low.
